designer.title: I'm a Designer
designer.headline: I can design things
designer.intro: I design products end to end, from research and flows to interfaces and design systems, and I test the decisions in code with real data.

searchbrand.title: Making AI visibility legible
searchbrand.body: A six-step onboarding that sets up the brand, then dashboards that turn LLM answers into metrics a marketing team can act on, on desktop and mobile.

socratia.title: A tutor with a personality
socratia.body: Delfí, a character with sixteen moods, plus voice classes and a learning journey that teaches through questions instead of answers.

audienceview.title: Checkout for live events
audienceview.body: Picking seats on the venue map, choosing price types and paying, for venues and performing arts organizations across the US, Canada and the UK.

betterfly.title: A design system for healthy habits
betterfly.body: Challenge components, the home screen and onboarding for an app that turns healthy habits into life-insurance coverage and donations.

problem.title: Start from the problem, not the screen
problem.body: Research, data and conversations with users and stakeholders come first. Every design decision should trace back to something we learned.

prototype.title: Prototype early, in code when it matters
prototype.body: Quick prototypes validate flows before polish. Code prototypes test them against real data, real content and edge cases.

systems.title: Systems over screens
systems.body: Components, tokens and patterns teams can reuse, so the product stays consistent as it grows.

measure.title: Measure what changes
measure.body: Designs are tied to product metrics, so after launch we know what worked and what to iterate on.

cta.title: Have something to design?
cta.body: From a first flow to a full design system, and I can build it too.

developer.title: I'm a Software Engineer
developer.headline: I can build things
developer.intro: I take products from an empty repo to production: frontend, backend, data and AI, plus native apps when the product calls for one.

searchbrand.title: Multi-LLM brand monitoring SaaS
searchbrand.body: A Turborepo monorepo: a Next.js app, a typed domain core on Drizzle and PostgreSQL, and Hono workers on Cloud Run that query Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity through async queues.

socratia.title: AI tutor with voice classes
socratia.body: A Next.js and Supabase app that teaches through questions instead of answers, with Claude-powered conversations and end-to-end tests in Playwright.

audioswitch.title: Native macOS utility
audioswitch.body: A menu-bar app in Swift that switches audio devices with a ⌘Tab-style shortcut, built on CoreAudio, AppKit and SwiftUI with zero dependencies.

loop.title: Design and code in one loop
loop.body: I prototype in code, so design decisions meet real data and real constraints early, not at handoff.

typed.title: I can React to Python, or just get Swiftie
typed.body: Web, backend or native, I pick up whatever the product needs and get productive fast: TypeScript and React, Python services, or Swift for Apple platforms.

ship.title: Ship small, ship often
ship.body: Development, staging, production. Small releases through CI, measured, then iterated.

ai.title: AI inside the product
ai.body: LLMs, voice and background workers wired into real product flows, with queues, retries and usage tracking. Not demos.

cta.title: Have something to build?
cta.body: From a first prototype to a production system, I can own it end to end.

portfolio.bio: Welcome to my portfolio, a sneak peek at my work. There's more, but we do have to prioritize.

cta.title: Let's build something together.
cta.body: Have an idea, a product or a feature that needs someone to design and build it end to end?
